meta.blog.html.description: Blog by Hospitality Energy Solutions. Insights on energy solutions, grid congestion, subsidies and sustainability for the hotel industry.
blog.intro: In-depth articles about energy independence, battery storage, EMS, charging infrastructure and subsidies, specifically for hoteliers.
blog.card1-title: EPBD IV: mandatory charging infrastructure for hotels
blog.card1-desc: From 2027, existing hotels with more than 20 parking spaces must have charging points. What does this mean for your hotel, and why is investing now smart?
blog.label: Keep reading
blog.card2-title: Legislation accelerates electric driving: the opportunity for your hotel
blog.card2-desc: Company-car taxation and EU policy are driving the growth of electric driving. Why your hotel needs charging infrastructure for business and private EV guests.
blog.card3-title: The netting scheme ends in 2027: what this means for your hotel
blog.card3-desc: From 1 January 2027 the net-metering scheme ends. Self-consumption, batteries and smart charging will determine the return on your solar panels.
blog.card4-title: SPRILA 2027: what the new round means for your hotel
blog.card4-desc: The SPRILA budget for 2026 is oversubscribed. The new round is expected to open at the end of January 2027. What that means for charging points and batteries in your car park.
